name: Benchmark Medieval Sword 02
prompt: Create one straight medieval longsword as a real editable Blender 3D prop. It has a long narrow tapered double-edged polished steel blade with a pointed tip, a horizontal steel crossguard perpendicular to the blade, a short dark leather-wrapped grip and a small round metal pommel at the opposite end. The entire object has a long slender sword silhouette, not a person, not a building, and not a weapon rack or display. Set brushed silver steel material for blade and dark leather for grip. Save the new Blender project and render, then open the viewport.
